subject: Architecture
title: AI-Generated Floor Plans
description: A fast breakdown of AI-Generated Floor Plans for builders.

hook.text: An AI can now generate thousands of floor plan options in seconds — a task that takes human architects weeks.

buildup.text: Generative design software inputs constraints — room sizes, sunlight, traffic flow — and produces optimal layouts.

discovery.text: Autodesk's generative design tool produced 10,000 layout options for its Toronto office — humans chose the best.

twist.text: AI doesn't replace architects — it handles the math while humans focus on beauty, culture, and meaning.

climax.text: Startups are using AI to design entire neighborhoods — optimizing for sunlight, wind, views, and walkability.

punchline.text: 10,000 options in seconds. The architect picks the one with soul.

quiz.question: How many layout options did Autodesk's AI generate for its Toronto office?
